sentences: Look down!
What color is the grass?
It is green!
But why is the grass green?
Let's find out!
Grass is a plant.
Plants need sunlight to live and grow.
They use sunlight to make food.
Grass does this every day!
Grass has a special green color inside it.
This color is called chlorophyll.
Chlorophyll helps plants use sunlight.
It is very important for plants.
Sunlight looks white.
But sunlight has many colors in it.
Some colors are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and violet.
Plants do not use all the colors in the same way.
Grass uses mostly red and blue light.
It does not use much green light.
The green light bounces back to our eyes.
That is why grass looks green!
Leaves are green too.
Many plants have chlorophyll.
That is why many trees, plants, and bushes look green.
Green is the color of healthy plants.
Why is the grass green?
Because it has chlorophyll.
Chlorophyll helps the plant use sunlight.
Green light bounces back to our eyes.
Now you know!
